name: Solo jazz guitar for a cocktail hour: a blues in the style of Grant Green
seoTitle: Solo jazz guitar for cocktail hour: Grant Green-style blues
description: This is a blues in the style of the jazz guitarist Grant Green, played on one guitar. One guitarist is a great choice for a cocktail hour or a dinner.
more: Your guitarist can sing or keep it instrumental, so just tell us which you'd like. With vocals, you'll hear blues, roots and singer-songwriter favorites. For guitar alone, we'd suggest jazz standards like Blue Bossa or some Spanish guitar pieces, and those are great during dinner.
